newsitem.title: UK: BSkyB to show Holyfield-Tyson on PPV.
newsitem.headline: BSkyB to show Holyfield-Tyson on PPV.

text.p: UK satellite television operator BSkyB Plc will show the June 28 heavyweight boxing fight between Evander Holyfield and Mike Tyson as a pay per view event, the company said in a statement.
The WBA title fight from Las Vegas will be available to Sky's domestic subscribers for 9.95 stg or 14.95 stg if the order is placed on the day of the fight.

BSkyB has experimented with a number of pay per view boxing events. It may introduce pay per view coverage of English premier league soccer once its 200 channel digital service is up and running in 1998.
